decision.explanation: The question asks who acquired 20th Century Fox. Source D1 confirms 'Marvin Davis and his family' bought the corporation in 1981. Source D2 confirms 'The Walt Disney Company' acquired Twenty-First Century Fox, Inc. in 2017. Source D3 contains a factual error ('The Walt Warner Bros Company') contradicting real-world facts and likely a typo in the source text (Warner Bros did not acquire 20th Century Fox; Disney did). As per instructions to treat sources as fallible and resolve contradictions based on context, the claim in D3 is rejected as incorrect, while the two distinct historical acquisitions (1981 and 2017) are retained as valid complementary answers.
